human_feedback_verbatim:
you should almost never take pandora's box as a boss relic reward, philosophers stone would be a better pick there.
you need to read what your cards do. vulnerable increases damage taken by enemies by 50%, if you are going to apply vulnerable to enemies, apply vulnerable first before attacking, not the other way around.
bludgeon is not a good card to take, demon form is always a good card to take at all times if given a choice. pummel is not really a good card to take unless u have strength gaining as well.
you had dropkick, and if you read the card description drop kick is basically a free card to use if the enemy is vulnerabled.
you also randomly used dexterity potion during the combat with the 3 birds when they had no intention of attacking.
summary: Authoritative human teaching stored verbatim for future runs.
